::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 9th 1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 99-100
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

Old proofs of these Christmas stories have fortunately been discovered so I send them off herewith.[^1]

I find I must ask you to be kind enough to let me have [£200 on account](organizations/other_160.qmd), or else £100 now and another £100 before Christmas. There  have been some unexpected calls upon me which drive me to ask this favour of you, though I am sorry to have to do so so early in the year

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

I suppose [Magnum Bonum](cmy_books/cmybook_131.qmd) will soon be put in hand

---

[^1]: She had been assembling the stories which were republished as *Bye-Words* (1880).
